name: A Rare Encounter
source:
It's your lunch break and you've found yourself sat down next to a bizarre goat who's snorting sugar. It certainly is a rare encounter, and you should make the most of it!

[from [url=https://sa-venn.itch.io/a-rare-encounter]itch.io[/url]]
